name: Example: Database Basics (SQLite create/insert/query)
description: Demonstrates the v8 Query Database / Execute Database Statement nodes: creates a local SQLite table, seeds it with rows from a loop, queries it back with a parameterized WHERE clause, and writes a summary. Fully offline and safe to Run repeatedly (drops/recreates the table each time). Switch the driver/connectionString fields to postgres/mysql to point at a real server instead -- the query/statement text (:name placeholders) stays identical across all three.

params.statement: CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER, customer TEXT, status TEXT, amount REAL)
INSERT INTO orders (id, customer, status, amount) VALUES (:id, :customer, :status, :amount)

params.query: SELECT customer, amount FROM orders WHERE status = :status ORDER BY amount DESC

params.content:
